Due to security protocols, a direct encrypted link cannot be established between Post Alpha and Post Bravo.
Furthermore, a mandatory routing rule stipulates that exactly one of the following two critical connections must be incorporated into the final loop: the link between Bravo and Charlie, or the link between Charlie and Delta.

The objective is to determine the minimal total cable length required to establish a single continuous communication loop that connects each observation post precisely once and returns to the origin point.
